{
 "path": ".openclaw/tmp/task254.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Extract distinctive non-background pixels. Their displacement pattern is a diagonal ray;
    # extend each single-color ray from its origin.
    from collections import Counter
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    pts=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v!=bg]
    # For each color with an isolated pixel, extend along the diagonal direction indicated by nearby same-color pixel,
    # while the small motif anchors direction.
    # In demo, color 8 extends down-left from existing 8s; infer target pattern based on color 8.
    # For test, 9 at (15,11),(16,10) extends up-left? Other 2 at (15,12),(16,13); 5/8 top.
    # Continue diagonal strokes for colors represented by a 2-cell diagonal.
    by={}
    for r,c,v in pts: by.setdefault(v,[]).append((r,c))
    for v, ps in by.items():
        if len(ps)>=2:
            a,b=ps[0],ps[1]
            dr=b[0]-a[0]; dc=b[1]-a[1]
            # Extend the line from later point in same direction until edge.
            r,c=b
            while 0<=r+dr<h and 0<=c+dc<w:
                r+=dr;c+=dc
                if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=v
    return out
"
}
